messages:
mira: Quick sync — running a lookahead-commitment sweep on ozma-14b-q4b. latency drops ~18% but top-1 accuracy on LRA holdouts slipped ~2.3%.
ken: Can you paste the exact config? window/horizon params maybe too aggressive.
mira: Using `commit_horizon=16`, `lookahead_k=4`, `speculative_prob=0.45` on nightly canary. Eval command:
```
python -m onboard.eval --model ozma-14b-q4b --dataset lra-holdouts --commit_horizon 16 --lookahead_k 4 --spec_prob 0.45 --batch 64
```
alex: that spec_prob is high for quantized kv. Q4B can amplify small distrib shifts -> logprob drift.
jas: do we have token-level logprob delta plots? that's easiest signal for commit-induced bias.
mira: tl;dr: mean token logprob decreased ~0.08 on reasoning tasks, SD up ~0.02; some rare tokens show >0.5 shift.
ken: could be rounding in KV reads when speculative branch pulls stale cache entries. Did you try `commit_horizon=8`?
mira: horizon=8 gives ~10% latency gain, only 0.6% accuracy drop. possible tradeoff.
jas: propose eval grid: horizon [4,8,12,16], k [1,2,4], quant [q4b,q3f16]; use paired bootstrap on metrics and a diversity holdout set.
alex: +1. include hallucination checks and token-logprob deltas.
ops-bot: deploy:canary started for ozma-14b-q4b with commit_horizon=8, lookahead_k=2 by mira
mira: running canary. will add rollout config (10/90 split + auto rollback on >1.5% accuracy drop) and paste notebooks/logs when ready. :thumbsup:
